responsibility: This file implements textual I/O and array-based conversion for ordinal numeric types in the mc-boot runtime. It reads and writes CARDINAL and INTEGER values through StrIO and provides conversion routines between strings and decimal, hexadecimal, octal, and binary representations, including width padding and manual parsers for signed or unsigned forms, making it the fixed-buffer ordinal conversion layer distinct from DynamicStrings-based StringConvert and floating-point FpuIO.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the implementation half of GNumberIO: it defines the parsing and formatting code for decimal, hex, octal, and binary integer/cardinal conversions and the StrIO-based read/write wrappers, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GNumberIO.h only declares that API.
